parole.testo: Possibly from Proto-Germanic *gutô (“Goth”), prior to Grimm's law.

parole.significato: priest (male religious official trained to perform and lead rituals at a church or temple)
parole.testo: From Proto-Germanic *kuningaz (“king”). Compare the shift from "king" to "priest" with Polish ksiądz (“priest”).
Borrowed from Proto-Germanic *hwaitijaz (“wheat”), apparently at a stage before Grimm's law was complete (that is, in the stage *k > h). Cognate with Latvian kviesis.
Ultimately from Proto-Germanic *salą (from whence French salle, German Saal). Compare Polish sala.
